exchangeFormat: IL: RST + IL county. Non-IL US: RST + state. Canada: RST + province. DX: RST + 'DX'. Bands 160-10m + 6m/2m (no WARC). CW/Phone/Digital. IL works everyone; non-IL works IL only. STANDARD/CLAIMED ruleset — built from the long-running ILQP format (WIARC, Sunday of the 3rd full October weekend); the supplied document had no rules text. Verify against the official WIARC ILQP PDF; the committee re-adjudicates.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ mults (counted ONCE, not per band/mode). Pts: Phone 1, CW & Digital 2. IL entrant mult = IL counties + each US state + each Canadian province + each DXCC country. Non-IL entrant mult = IL counties. IL works everyone; non-IL scores IL contacts only (non-IL↔non-IL no credit). IL mobile/rover county-change = new QSO + new county. STANDARD/CLAIMED — built from the long-running ILQP format because the supplied document contained only WIARC website metadata (no rules body). Points/multiplier/bonus structure must be verified against the official WIARC ILQP rules PDF; the WIARC club station W9AWE may carry a sponsoring-club bonus in some years (NOT applied — off-log/claimed, not fabricated). IL county abbreviations are NOT bundled (by-exclusion, not invented). Power/operator categories not applied. The ILQP committee re-adjudicates.
